clockRule: Tracker sample=t_V+3. Video source clock=(sample-1)*dt=(t_V+2)*dt; simulation elapsed=t_V*dt because t0=sample3. A dt=1s from30fps/stride30; B/C/E/F dt=29/29.97s. Cross-camera synchronization is not independently verified.
phaseRole: Display/evaluation annotation from Vivian animate.py; never drives demand, routes, population resets or dynamics.

pressure.thresholdRule: max(occupancy-weighted75th percentile of observed grid density in preceding60s, occupancy-weighted99th percentile of isolated-agent density at the same positions)
pressure.mechanism: Same grid occupancy-pressure law with each receiver own deposition removed from pressure used for that receiver feedback. Total density/pressure fields remain descriptive; no new force, pressure fit or rho0 change.
pressure.activation: Nonzero applied velocity corrections / all agent-substeps, every run reports numerator and denominator
pressure.gate: Numerical finite/conservation/denominator/off-silence checks are blocking. The old5% C/E activation target is reported only, including inactive/low cases; do not lower rho0 or tune any parameter.
pressure.amaxSelection: One doubled cap1.6 versus baseline.8, selected before rerunning; report clipped corrections and gate, never select a winning setting
pressure.gridPhase: For axis x/y, SHA256(JSON.stringify([stadium-grid-phase-v4,seed,axis])), first uint32 little endian /2^32*h; origin U[0,h)^2, same global seed across windows and all methods including off
pressure.thresholdPolicy: One calibration from first60s of each recording, every5 native samples. Same occupied-node weighted Q75 versus isolated Q99 max. Nominal grid origin for calibration; per-seed random origin for simulation. No later recalibration.
pressure.calibrationOverlap: Retrospective first-minute calibration overlaps evaluation at start, not prior-to-t0 or online predictive calibration.

speed.history: Use speed from the last two consecutive historical positions; for an arrival the history ends at the START of its timeBracket, before any sampled arrival time
speed.knownHistory: v0_i=max(.03,own historical displacement speed), without Q75 replacement or additional multiplicative noise
speed.insufficientHistory: Seeded draw from consecutive speed observations ending inside ROI, with jitteredArrival-60 <= speedObservation.time <= arrival.timeBracket[0]. Initially no history:0.03. Known individual history remains unchanged.
speed.maximumSpeed: Controlled velocity limit1.55*v0_i before and after pressure; disk/wall position projection is separately diagnosed

demand.boundaryArrival: Consecutive outside-to-inside crossing, confirmed by two consecutive inside samples; keep one admission episode per sourceID and exclude initially present IDs
demand.arrivalTime: Uniform jitter within the native outside/first-inside timeBracket, conditional on the recorded boundary demand; paired across methods for the same seed
demand.tunnelBirth: A newly appearing sourceID in the visible y<0 tunnel strip between finite tunnel walls, confirmed by two inside samples, becomes an inferred arrival at the deep cut with outward route
demand.inferredPlacement: Use tunnel-relative lateral fraction and body-clearance projection onto the deep cut; no direct injection at the observed interior location
demand.deduplication: One sourceID once over full recording; rejected repeated entries retained in audit.
demand.observationBirths: Other interior births remain track-quality residuals; no population resetting
demand.coverage: Report before/after event counts and uniqueIDs, directional reference crossings, and prior-presence/sourceID-based potential explanatory coverage; coverage is not simulated success

missingObservations: Native frames with no tracker rows are unknown (agents:null). Exclude from count/FD metrics. Never use Vivian interpolated flow values as observed counts. No displacement or boundary crossing across missing frames.
informationBoundary: Recorded arrivals and initial histories supply conditional demand; no reference exit/occupancy resets or feedback. First60s threshold exception declared explicitly.
geometry: Frozen v3 geometry and v3b lane guards. D saved user ROI remains outside this five-camera protocol.
recording: Exact saved native states plus every10s and phase boundaries; dt<=0.02. Additional recording boundaries may split final substep but never modify stepper.

numericGates.activationPolicy: Report any value; never tune, discard seeds, or fail based on activation rate.

confidenceIntervals.pairedDefinition: feedback_on minus feedback_off; sensitivity feedback_on_amax1p6 minus feedback_on
confidenceIntervals.interpretation: Conditional simulation-seed uncertainty; not ground-truth accuracy or independent-video generalization uncertainty
confidenceIntervals.retainFailedOrSparse: All declared cases remain visible; no seed dropping or post-outcome threshold tuning

queueRegion.definition: Mouth-centered1W-wide strip extending1W toward plaza/approach, intersect common observation floor

fundamentalDiagram.kernel: Same isotropic2D Gaussian for both sources; truncate at3sigma and renormalize retained disk
fundamentalDiagram.speed: Norm of last consecutive native-sample displacement divided by actual source time interval (approximately1s); no gap bridging or3-pointOLS
fundamentalDiagram.aggregation: Pool all included windows by method; report per-density-bin speed and rho*speed median,Q25,Q75, agent-time count, distinct windows and seeds. Observations included once; seeded simulation points are conditional realizations, not independent videos.
fundamentalDiagram.flowProxy: rho times speed magnitude, people/(W*s), separate from directional mouth crossing throughput
